protocol.source: published Binance BTC/USDT spot 1h acquisition; no exchange mixing

evaluation_rules.selection_only: 2024 development folds, no independent validation claim
evaluation_rules.state: each candidate/fold starts with 1000 USDT, no transferred positions
evaluation_rules.warmup: past only, at least 200 hours before each evaluation
evaluation_rules.fold_boundary: data ends at 23:00 UTC preceding exclusive end; final hourly close one hour earlier
evaluation_rules.baseline_stake: original frozen strategy/config behavior; candidates fixed risk sizing
evaluation_rules.costs: native 10 bps/side; execution/extra fees require separate sensitivity
evaluation_rules.risk_state: native backtests do not model paper persisted drawdown/cooldown
evaluation_rules.promotion: none; criteria in docs/experiment-plan.md; cost and marked-equity replay still required
